en.general: The choosing, by a ranking or recommender system, of which items (posts, songs, articles, contacts) reach a person and in what order. Such systems add no new items of their own, but they affect which existing items are kept and passed on. Wording for students: the feed decides what you meet first.

examples: A feed that shows posts with many reactions first, so that popular posts reach still more people.
